title: timerpluginmutils
description:
Adds a fully customizable timer system to your Minecraft server!
Features a global timer visible to all players, personal timers for individual players, BossBar display, and automated rules like stopping the timer when the Ender Dragon dies.
body:
TimerPlugin brings a flexible and easy-to-use timer system to your Minecraft server, compatible with Paper. It’s perfect for minigames, challenges, speedruns, or just tracking gameplay time.

Features:

Global Timer: Counts server-wide time for all players. Visible with a clean BossBar display. Pause, resume, or reset anytime with /timer commands.

Personal Timers: Each player can have their own private timer, visible only to them, controllable with /ptimer commands.

Event Automation: Automatically stops the global timer when the Ender Dragon is defeated. (Optional rules for player deaths can be added.)

Customizable HUD: Displays minutes and seconds clearly on a BossBar at the top of the screen.

Player Opt-in: Players can choose personal timers while the global timer continues for others.

Easy Commands: Intuitive commands make timer control simple: /timer resume|pause|reset and /ptimer resume|pause|reset.

Why use TimerPlugin?

Perfect for server events, minigames, and timed challenges

Helps track progress for speedruns or competitions

Lightweight and fully compatible with Paper servers
